Huawei Cloud Terraform Generator v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a guided workflow to generate and deploy Huawei Cloud infrastructure using Terraform.
- Proposes resource plans and confirms key parameters interactively, minimizing manual input.
- Handles AK/SK/STS credentials with explicit environment variable usage and error reporting.
- Enforces verification of every resource specification in the target region before writing Terraform code, using skill-to-skill resource queries.
- Ensures user confirmation before deployment, covering ports/security groups and resource details.
- Adheres strictly to forbidden guidance: no fabricated specs, no default ports without user consent, and no skipping verification steps.
